options.name: Aiding Attack
options.benefit: After you hit, the next ally attacking that target gains +2 circumstance on the attack.

options.name: Bolster Companion
options.benefit: Give your companion +4 AC and CMD against one attack and halve its damage if it still hits.

options.name: Catfall
options.benefit: Ignore the first 20 feet of a fall and remain standing if the fall deals no damage.

options.name: Chameleon Step
options.benefit: Move up to twice speed without taking the movement penalty on Stealth.

options.name: Cunning Pantomime
options.benefit: Communicate slowly with one creature as tongues for 10 minutes.

options.name: Defensive Bow Stance
options.benefit: Your ranged attacks do not provoke until your next turn.

options.name: Deft Stand
options.benefit: Stand from prone as a move action without provoking.

options.name: Distracting Attack
options.benefit: A creature you hit takes –2 on attacks for 1 round.

options.name: Hateful Attack
options.benefit: Double the threat range for one attack against a favored enemy.

options.name: Heel
options.benefit: Let your companion leave its square without provoking and end adjacent to you.

options.name: Hobbling Attack
options.benefit: A creature you hit has its land speed halved for 1d4 rounds.

options.name: Quick Climb
options.benefit: Climb at full speed as a move action without penalty.

options.name: Quick Healing
options.benefit: Administer first aid as a swift action or give an unconscious creature a potion as a move action.

options.name: Quick Swim
options.benefit: Swim at full speed as a move action without penalty.

options.name: Ranger's Counsel
options.benefit: Give allies within 30 feet +2 on one skill in which you have at least 1 rank for 1 round.

options.name: Rattling Strike
options.benefit: A creature struck by your melee attack is shaken for 1d4 rounds.

options.name: Second Chance Strike
options.benefit: Reroll a missed melee attack at –5 as an immediate action.

options.name: Sic 'Em
options.benefit: Command your animal companion to make one melee attack as a swift action.

options.name: Skill Sage
options.benefit: Roll twice and take the better result on a trained skill check.

options.name: Stag's Leap
options.benefit: Attempt a running jump without a 10-foot run-up.

options.name: Surprise Shift
options.benefit: Move 5 feet as a swift action without provoking or consuming your 5-foot step.

options.name: Tangling Attack
options.benefit: A creature struck by your attack is entangled for 1 round.

options.name: Trick Shot
options.benefit: Make a ranged attack that ignores concealment, soft cover, and partial cover.

options.name: Uncanny Senses
options.benefit: Gain +10 insight on Perception for 1 round as an immediate action.

options.name: Upending Strike
options.benefit: After a melee hit, make a free trip combat maneuver against the target.

options.name: Vengeance Strike
options.benefit: Make an immediate melee attack against an adjacent enemy that hits your ally.
